notes.softspine: Slice: Tech spine T1-T33 (28 nodes) + Software Development T-SD001-056 (56 nodes) = 84 existing, plus 3 new nodes (T-301 Command Line Basics, T-302 Regular Expressions, T-303 How the Internet Works). Stage fixes: T-SD024 'HTML to Web Fundamentals' Mastery->Integration (it precedes Integration nodes T-SD025/026); T-SD042 'Web Development Pathways' Integration->Mastery (its hard prereq T-SD041 Full-Stack is Mastery). All other stages kept. Hard prereqs derived from existing prerequisite_hard edges; cross_domain edges (C*, E*, LS*, SC*, M-*, P*, L-* ids) intentionally excluded from hard_prereqs/soft_deps and preserved separately upstream. One added hard edge: T-301 -> T5 (File Management now formally requires Command Line Basics). External ids referenced in soft_deps only: T-RB026 (Sensor Read) on T26, T-RB019 (Mech-Control Integr.) on T27 - both robotics-domain, owned by the other agent, referenced but not modified. T-SD001/002/003 remain Foundations roots of the Software strand (no hard prereqs, soft-linked to K-5 spine via T5/T1) since the strand starts at 6-8 and hard-linking to Fluency-stage spine nodes would violate the stage_id<=child rule. Grade bands: spine K-2 (T1-T4), 3-5 (T5-T8, T28, T-301), 6-8 (T9-T11, T19, T20, T22, T25, T29, T31, T303), 9-10 (T12-T16, T26, T32, T302), 11-12 (T17, T27, T33); Software strand 6-8 through 11-12, non-decreasing along prereq chains.
notes.robotics: Robotics slice T-RB001-T-RB100 (100 nodes, 5 clusters). Stages recomputed from longest-path depth along prerequisite_hard edges so every cluster progresses Foundations (entry Basics node) -> Fluency -> Application -> Integration -> Mastery monotonically; this repairs the inverted staging in Tech Designer (Design Portfolio was Foundations, now Mastery capstone; Labeled Sketch now Fluency) and Innovator (Team Lead now Integration, Public Present/Scale Plan/Final Prototype now Mastery/Integration). Hard prereqs taken verbatim from the 134 in-slice prerequisite_hard edges in tech_edges.json; the graph was already acyclic and fully connected, and is stage-monotone under the new staging (verified). External refs: the edge file contains NO edges from the T1-T33 spine into this slice, so none were dropped; T25 (Robotics Basics) is referenced as a soft_dep on the five entry nodes T-RB001-005 only - no external hard_prereqs. Assessment honesty: physical builds, breadboarding, soldering, multimeter work, CAD, prototypes, interviews, and presentations are teacher-rubric projects (4 criteria each); simulator-gradable coding nodes (incl. T-RB029 Sensor Logic) are quest/robot; calculable/reasonable knowledge nodes (Ohm's law, gear ratios, power budgets, materials and goals trade-offs, component ID) are quest/concept. atomic=false on multi-skill capstones: T-RB018, T-RB019, T-RB080, T-RB096, T-RB098. Grade bands: simplest mechanical/design intros (T-RB001/004/006/007/061) are 3-5; other Foundations/Fluency/Application 6-8; Integration 9-10; Mastery 11-12 except practical HS electronics T-RB039/040/041/042 at 9-10.
